reason: A DSH web overlay that retrieves authenticated Tonghuashun portfolio data and visualizes position profit and loss, index values, and intraday trends.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面中获取同花顺投资账本的持仓数据，并以可拖动浮窗展示盈亏、上证指数和分时走势图。
summaries.en: A DSH web overlay that fetches Tonghuashun investment-ledger holdings and displays profit and loss, the Shanghai Composite Index, and an intraday chart.

capabilities: Reads a configured Tonghuashun session cookie reference
Fetches authenticated portfolio, profit-and-loss, and index data from Tonghuashun endpoints
Displays portfolio metrics and an intraday chart in a draggable web overlay
Stores display position and selected portfolio settings in localStorage
